title: الإحالة تلحق الشكل

steps.say: نعطي الرسم وسمًا (label) يبدأ بـ fig-، فيصير شكلًا مرقّمًا. لاحظ أن عنوانه صار يبدأ بـ «Figure 1».
نكتب @fig-trend في النص، ويكتب Quarto مكانها «Figure 1» رابطًا للشكل. ولو نقلت الرسم لمكان ثاني، الرقم يلحقه.
والجداول نفس الشيء: وسم يبدأ بـ tbl-، وعنوان في tbl-cap، و@tbl-latest في المكان اللي يحتاجه النص.
القسم يحتاج شيئين: معرّف زي {#sec-method}، وعناوين مرقّمة بـ number-sections: true. وبعدها تطلع @sec-method في النص «Section 2».

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tinytable)
rates <- read_csv("unemployment.csv")
REGION <- "Jazan"
now <- rates |>
  filter(region == REGION, quarter == "2025Q4") |>
  pull(rate)
then <- rates |>
  filter(region == REGION, quarter == "2022Q1") |>
  pull(rate)
```

## Summary

Unemployment **fell** in most regions between 2022 and 2025.
*Jazan* is the exception. This note shows the national
trend (@fig-trend) and the latest rates
(@tbl-latest).[^1]

In `r REGION` the rate was
`r scales::number(now, accuracy = 0.1)`% in 2025 Q4,
against `r scales::number(then, accuracy = 0.1)`% in
2022 Q1: a change of
`r scales::number(now - then, accuracy = 0.1, style_positive = "plus")`
points.

The data cover:

- 13 regions and the Kingdom as a whole
- 16 quarters, from 2022 Q1 to 2025 Q4

@sec-method defines the rate.

Official figures are on the [GASTAT website](https://www.stats.gov.sa).

[^1]: All figures in this note are synthetic, made for training.

## Method {#sec-method}

The unemployment rate is

$$
u = \frac{U}{U + E} \times 100
$$

where $U$ is the number unemployed and $E$ the number employed.

## Data

```{r}
glimpse(rates)
```

## Trend

```{r}
#| label: fig-trend
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 3.5
#| fig-cap: "Unemployment rate, Kingdom, 2022 to 2025 (%)"
kingdom <- rates |> filter(region == "Kingdom")
ggplot(kingdom, aes(date, rate)) + geom_line()
```

```{r}
#| layout-ncol: 2
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-cap: !expr c("The Kingdom", REGION)
ggplot(kingdom, aes(date, rate)) + geom_line()
rates |>
  filter(region == REGION) |>
  ggplot(aes(date, rate)) + geom_line()
```

## Latest rates

```{r}
#| label: tbl-latest
#| tbl-cap: "Unemployment rate by region, 2025 Q4 (%)"
latest <- rates |> filter(quarter == "2025Q4")
latest |>
  arrange(rate) |>
  select(Region = region, `Rate (%)` = rate) |>
  tt() |>
  format_tt(digits = 1, num_fmt = "decimal",
            num_zero = TRUE) |>
  theme_html(portable = TRUE)
```
